newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Reno Air rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Reno Air rated a buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Bros analyst Brian Harris said he initiated coverage of Reno Air Inc with a buy recommendation.
-- He said the stock's recent price decline over the past three weeks to around eight from almost 13 has created "an excellent entry point" to get into the stock.

-- "The stock has been beaten up in last few weeks on fuel (price) fears and Southwest's (Airlines Co ) fare sale. But there are structural improvements underway, an improved schedule, fuel price should stabilize and the West Coast pricing environment should continue to improve" with Southwest shifting its attention to Eastern United States markets, Harris said.
-- He said he expects the company to earn $0.51 per share in 1996 and $1.35 next year.
-- His 12-month price target is $11 per share.
-- In midmorning Nasdaq trade, the shares gained 3/8 to 8-5/8.
